contributions.statement: Accept a context-compression or compaction option only after testing it on end-to-end multi-step agent runs on your own repos, not on single-shot retention: ICAE matched or beat the base model on SQuAD and RepoQA yet resolved 7 vs 19 of 500 SWE-bench Verified issues.
contributions.evidence: §3 Table 1 and App. B: single-shot vs agentic results on Qwen3-8B, 5 runs on SWE-bench Verified. SFT baseline confounded (full FT vs LoRA), p-values inconsistent across sections.
relative_to: P08 compaction evaluated on single-shot retention (2608.24188)

contributions.statement: Do not let compaction paraphrase exact identifiers, file paths or URLs that exact-match edit tools depend on.
contributions.evidence: §4: hallucinated paths/URLs after compression offered as the mechanism; untested hypothesis.

reason: The replicated negative result supplies the 'single-shot retention does not predict agent success' condition for evaluating compaction. Its mechanism story is untested and already shown elsewhere.
